dedupe_keys.name: luxembourg digital national road network reseau routier numerique from the administration des ponts et chaussees node edge geopackage with lanes widths gradients and road classes

description: The Administration des Ponts et Chaussées publishes the digital road network of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg on the national open data portal. Contents: a node-edge model of every state road, meaning motorways (A), expressways (B), national roads (N) and chemins repris (CR), with link geometry, road width, number of lanes, gradients, junctions, road classification, one-way streets and motorway rest areas, following the static road data types of EU Delegated Regulation 2022/670 on real-time traffic information services; French and German guides with a coding annex explain each attribute. The geoportal also serves a 2025 functional classification of the state road network (motorways, international and national links, traffic distribution roads) as OGC API Features collections. Producer: the Administration des Ponts et Chaussées, the national road authority. Coverage: all national roads of Luxembourg; municipal roads and cycle paths are not included. Format and access: one GeoPackage of about 21 MB with PDF guides, downloadable without registration; the publication date gives the network status. Licence: Creative Commons CC0. Caveats: municipal streets must be added from other sources for full routing, and the file is a snapshot, not a live feed. Simulation uses: national road network models for traffic assignment, accessibility and detour analysis when roads are closed by floods, and linking the traffic counts of the same administration. Related records: PCH national road traffic counts (data-pch-luxembourg-national-road-traffic-counts) and the Luxembourg flood hazard maps (data-luxembourg-flood-and-heavy-rainfall-hazard-maps).
